tower-of-life-starting-the-quest.player: Hi. Interesting building you have here.

tower-of-life-starting-the-quest.npc: You like it? It's simply fabulous, isn't it? A real marvel of modern design made just for my fellow alchemists and I!

tower-of-life-starting-the-quest.player: I see some builders over there. So I assume it's not yet finished.

tower-of-life-starting-the-quest.npc: What a keen eye this chap has! But imagine this: a gargantuan cylinder of expert design, incorporating an inventive inner spiral walkway to multiple planes of wondrous inhabitance!
It's going to have a use that will change this world!
Or at least it would if we could ever get it finished.

tower-of-life-starting-the-quest.player: They don't seem to be building much.

tower-of-life-starting-the-quest.npc: They've gone on strike for some petty reason about the tower being too weird. I really can't understand those men.
Hey! Maybe you could talk to them?
You look like a sturdy chap.
Maybe you could finish the work?
Come on! This is the chance of a lifetime!

tower-of-life-starting-the-quest.prompt: Start the Tower of Life quest?

steps.npc: That's fantastic! Oh, I'm so pleased.

steps.player: Calm down. I'm not making any promises.

steps.npc: Oh, I have a good feeling about this.
Go have a word with Bonafido the head builder. See if you can't get him off his backside to do some work. Oh, and I'm Effigy by the way.

steps.player: Nice to meet you Effigy, I'm [player name]. Hold on and I'll see what I can do!

steps.text: If the player has completed Making History:

steps.npc: Don't I recognise you from somewhere?
Do you know the outpost north of Ardougne?

steps.player: Ah, yes, it's now a small museum. Jorral's looking after it. He's really making history with that place.

steps.npc: Well, the King was going to make that into an alchemy lab for us, but some fool ruined our plans!

steps.player: Ah, yes. Shame. Got to go. Bye.
Best I go sort out this tower. Bye.
Sorry, feeling a bit ill today.

steps.npc: That's a weak excuse for a very feeble personality.
